Specification: This module is a small test specification for operators from an external undirected-graph library. It checks graph path and connectivity behavior on several concrete graph values using ASSUME statements, including empty graphs, a graph with one edge, and a larger connected graph. The file does not define a transition system or temporal behavior of its own; instead, it encodes assertion-style validation of imported graph operators such as SimplePath, ConnectedComponents, AreConnectedIn, and IsStronglyConnected.
AssumptionNames: LET T == INSTANCE TLC IN T!PrintT("UndirectedGraphsTests")

LET G == [edge|-> {{1,2}}, node |-> {1,2,3}]
       IN  /\ AssertEq(ConnectedComponents(G), {{1,2}, {3}})
           /\ AreConnectedIn(1, 2, G)
           /\ ~ AreConnectedIn(1, 3, G)

LET G == [node |-> {1,2,3,4,5},
                 edge |-> {{1,3}, {1,4}, {2,3}, {2,4}, {3,5}, {4,5}}]
       IN  /\ AssertEq(ConnectedComponents(G), {{1,2,3,4,5}})
           /\ IsStronglyConnected(G)
